text: What if you found a jar of gold under land you just bought?
Whose is it? Yours? Or the man who sold it to you?
The Prophet, peace be upon him, told us: a man bought land from another man.
And in that land, he found a jar full of gold.
He went back to the seller and said: Take your gold. I bought the land from you, not the gold.
The seller said: I sold you the land, and everything in it.
So they went to a man to judge between them.
He asked: Do you have children? One said: I have a boy. The other said: I have a girl.
He said: Marry the boy to the girl. Spend on them from it... and give in charity.
They argued to give, not to take. Return one thing today that is not yours.
